<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 193.1103 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈192.103 Da. The formula C₈H₁₆O₅ matches this mass closely (exact mass 192.0998 Da, within a few millidaltons) and the observed isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈12 % intensity) is consistent with a molecule containing eight carbons. No other heteroatoms are required to explain the data, so the molecular formula is C₈H₁₆O₅.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H16O5</final_answer>
